column1: Checklist Question
Are all certificates valid (including calibration certs as per AD-04)?
Any major surveys / CSM items due next 3 months. If any overdue, to be dealt with immediately?
Any COCs on vessel. Check due dates?
Review of last Internal Audit/PSC/FSI/Vetting Reports. Any remarks/observations outstanding? If closed, is the closure effective?
Contact point list of SOPEP is updated.?
All ITU publications provided onboard are up-to-date.?
Latest nautical publications are available on board.?
Endorsement by Flag State of crew certificate are valid.?
Any past PSC detentions/SIRE refusals?
Seafarer Employment Agreement (SEA) is valid within the contract period. The contract period of SEA is checked to be in line with company procedure.?
Wage is paid in monthly interval in accordance with SEA/CBA.?
Condition of Accomodation AC / heating?
Availability of normal temp/hot water at all decks?
Condition of provisions/potable fresh water?
Record of potable water testing?
Housekeeping and hygiene in galley and common spaces in accommodation. Galley floor tiles in good condition, no leaking taps.?
Fire doors closing properly. No stoppers or hold-backs in place to keep doors open, (including those in the galley, store rooms, mess rooms)?
Cleanliness of common toilets on various decks?
Cleanliness of individual cabins, including toilets?
Cleanliness of Hospital, Record and availability of medicines, condition of Medical oxygen and equipment. Test of call alarm.?

Crew contracts - crew member must be performing duties for which the contract is signed. For e.g - a person having signed a contract as wiper cannot be shown performing motorman duty even if he has a watchkeeping certificate.?
LSA / FFA Equipment and Systems?

Fixed fire fighting system for ER and pump room last tested/next testing due. If CO2 system, check validity of cylinder weightment and pressure testing dates ; check that flexible hoses for CO2 system have been renewed at 10 years interval.?

Fixed fire fighting system for deck on tankers last tested/next testing due. If foam system, check foam type and analysis reports , level of compound in foam tank (reqd qty of foam compound as per calculations in Foam system manual to be displayed at tank. Level corresponding to this approved quantity to be marked on level gauge.?
Fixed deck water spray system for gas carriers and IGF code vessels?
Fixed gas detection system on IGF code vessels for Fuel Preparation Room on IGF Code vessels?
Fixed fire fighting system for paint store/Sample locker?
Portable fire extinguishers last tested and charged. Date of servicing/pressure testing should be valid.?
Condition of main fire pumps/Emcy fire p/p. Pumps tried out?
Condition of hoses and nozzles  Samples Checked ?
Condition of fire line on deck & ER - any leakages/doublers/soft patches / temporary repairs?
Condition of fire line isolating  valve. For tankers, condition of main deck line isolating valves?
Foam compound   last test date / shelf life?
Quick closing valves & mechanism, check of operation.?
Functioning of Remote stops and funnel flaps (including remote stops for IGF Code vessels)?
Condition of cargo hold ventilator flaps/pump room blowers high/low suction flaps / flaps of all natural and mechanical ventilators on deck.?
Condition of accommodation vents / recirc flaps of AC system?
Fire detection & alarm system  condition of sensors/test record / test gas(should be non flammable type for tankers)?
Condition of  lifeboat structure?
Condition of lifeboat machinery including covers. Engines Tried Out. Starting battery expiry date (or supply date) and spare starting motor.?

Lifeboat launching arrangement - condition of davits, hoisting winch motor, limit switches, embarkation ladders (including the condition of spliced ends), remote lowering mechanism/wire condition. Posters on bulkheads?
Lifeboat falls next renewal due?
Condition of  lifeboat equipment?
Condition of liferafts, cradles, symbols?
Condition of SCBA compressor and equipment?
Condition of lifebouys on deck & bridge wings. MOB marker buoy to be of correct weight?
Condition of life jackets (including oversize ones) with lights checked  at random.?
Pressure testing of fire hoses at random?
Condition and test record of immersion suits. Crew able to demonstrate the wearing of immersion suit in 3 mins? Size of immersoin suits proper for the crew on board?
Condition and number of EEBDs. Service records availability. If replacecable type, validity of expiry date?
Rescue boat condition, launching and davit. If davit is equipped with hydraulic accumulator, it should be able to hold the hydraulic pressure. Test /service records are also important?
Overall condition. Any oil stains/coating breakdown on shipsides?
Last 2 Thickness measurement reports (Sonic Guaging reports) for hull/decks/bulkkheads available and in good oder?
Review of survey statements for prior damages and reports?
Any visible dents? If yes, are they included in Class records?
Condition of tank domes/operating mechanism. Any signs of leakage from packing?
Condition of cargo hold hatch covers/packing and operating mechanism. Any hydraulic leaks / non operational hydraulic motors?
Condition of PV valves and maintenance/testing records?
Condition of Cargo tank level gauging system - Remote ullaging, functioning of high level alarms, independent hi-hi level alarms, secondary means of venting (pressure sensors). ROB of spares?
Condition of access ladders inside the cargo holds?
Cargo hold water ingress alarms - function test and records?
Cargo hold hatch covers operation and weather tightness.?
Cleats are freely moving and in good condition?
Entry procedure in place & comm sys in order?
General inspection of Lighting, Light fittings, Emergency lights, stub pipes & cable glands?
Fixed Gas detection system?
Cargo p/p trips and remote stops?
Seachest and ovbd v/v testing arrangement?
Emcy op. Of hyd v/vs of VRCS?
Bilge alarm and pumping arrangement?
Condition of light fittings on the forward side of the accommodation. For tankers, must be Explosion proof and in intact/gas tight condition.?
ODMCS operation/records. Review of ORB Part II entries?
Seals of cargo and ballast pumps - free of leakages and clean bilges/tanktop?
Housekeeping and painting?
Smart operation of Pump room blower flaps both at top and bottom of pump room.?
Pump room booby hatch cover, skylight condition?
Last 2 Shore service reports of all LSA/FFA euipment. Any concerns identified. Pressure testing record of extinguishers/CO2 bottles?
Check of records of Saturday Routines/ Monthly / Quarterly Routines of Safety / Pollution Prevention Equipment. Any concerns here to be immediately attended?
Random Check of records for drills as per drill planner. Debrief with crew on last held drill.?
Emergency Generator - function test, spare starting motor, starting battery supply date (to be within 2 years) ; QC valve for independent Fuel tank?
Random check of Fireman Suits and equipment, communication eqpt, safety posters, availability of LSA/FFA training manuals at common places?

Operating condition of Radars, ECDIS, AIS , BNWAS, Magnetic Compass, Gyro, Anemometer, Doppler Log, Echosounder, VDR, Chart Recorder, RPM and Rudder Angle Indicators (including those on bridge wings).?
Familiarity of crew with ECDIS?
Operational status of EPIRB / SART?
All bridge equipment PMS checked/defects identified. Spares maintained as required.?
All Nautical Publications updated and available including USCG 33 & 46 CFR; USCG Navigation Rules - International - Inland?
Review of last dynamic navigation audit and PSC/Vetting deficiencies on navigation/bridge?
Random Check of chart correction status?
Workstation for Cargo Tank Remote Level gauging system?
Cargo tank pressure sensors (all should be operational) and spare sensors?
Operating condition of VRCS and important spares?
Operating condition of Valve indicators and controls?
Operating condition of Cargo Tank Overfill Alarm System?
Operating conditon of Loadicator and record of test reports (for all ships)?
Random check of Enclosed Space entry permits / Hot work permits / Ship Shore safety checklists / MSDS of cargoes?
Enough portable radios available and in good working condition?
Calibration records of portable gas meters and UTIs and minimum spares available on board?
Structural and painting condition of main decks. TM reports available for review.?
Condition of pipe supports, catwalk, ladders, gangways and net for same?
Condition and pressure test records of cargo lines, tk cleaning  line, IG line, bunker lines. Condition of service air lines, conduits, hydraulic lines of deck including pipe supports and clamps?
Any pipelines on deck or deck plating having doublers/soft patches/leakages / temporary repairs?
Condition of P/V Breaker, guage glass, Deck Seal, plating under deck seal.?
Condition of light fittings, ladders, portholes on accom decks?
Airpipe coaming (save alls) & head in good conditon without heavy corrosion or holes.?
Loadline marks, draft marks visible/painted?
Function test of Pumping arrangements for bosun store, steering flat?
Condition of cargo manifold for tankers - drip tray, gratings, drain lines, pipe supports, manifold valves, thickness of manifold flange, condition of spare reducers?
15 ppm OWS , ODME, sewage plant (STP), incinerator - operation/test records. Effluent test records for STP.?
SOPEP locker equipment adequate?
Garbage Management Plan and posters kept updated?
Oil record book entries in order?
Ops/maintenance records of system. Effluent test records.?
Does vessel have compliant fuel on board?
Inspection Records?
Review of coating condition as per maintenance records?
Review of piping system/valve integrity as per maintenance records.?
Operate the crane and check the functioning of limit switches (Hoisting, Traverse/Slewing End limits)?
Check the condition of wires (no broken strands, kinks) and check that spare wire is available.?
Check condition of Swivel, Sheaves, shackle, hook, safety latch and drum for cracks, abnormalities.?
Availability of emergency operating kit for hose handling crane for tankers?
Is the Register of Cargo Machinery and Lifting Gear completed and up to date?
Condition of windlass/winch machinery / brake lining /  foundation.  Availability of spare brake lining and Brake holding test kit?
Condition of mooring ropes/wires/tails?
Condition  of  anchor  chain as visible?
Review of MSMP and LMP. Physical verification of mooring winches/system/acessories/ropes/wires for wear and tear and suitability?
Housekeeping, Painting and Lighting?
Condition of ER piping - leaks/soft patches/ temporary repairs?
Condition of ER piping below floor plates - leaks/soft patches/ temporary repairs?
Condition of SW main line in bilges - leaks/soft patches/ temporary repairs?
Oil/water leaks from ME components?

Steering gear and associated machinery - telemotor controls ; rudder angle indicator, Gyro repeater, communication with Navigation console, hydraulic oil leaks , system alarms and trips, emergency steering arrangement.?
Operating condition of AE (each must be able to take at least 80% of rated load)?
Oil/water leaks from AE. Drip tray of each AE to be clean and well painted.?
Auto operating condition of aux boiler and IG system (for tankers)?
Calibration record of ER alarms/trips in PMS?
Operating condition of heavy duty electrical motors?
Operating condition and running hours/day of Main Air Compressor?
Operating condition of Accom AC system and prov refrigeration system?
Operating condition of Main Sea Water pumps / Boiler feed water pumps / ME associated pumps / FO supply/circulating pumps?
Review of PMS for ME / AE / Aux Boiler/ SW pumps / Purifiers/ Main Air Compressors/Cranes?
Random check of critical spares/essential spares ROB?

Note - Each category gives guidance on it's own score. Even though total score may be in above mentioned ranges, a low score in individual categories should drive an expanded inspection in those areas of concern.?
